 ANNE ARUNDEL COUNTY, Md. (WBFF) — A Pasadena woman has been charged with stealing $32,571 in cash from a Maryland Renaissance Festival food stand where she was employed.
 Amy Lynn Fitzgerald, 41, was charged Tuesday in Anne Arundel County with two felonies related to the alleged thefts, according to court records.
 On Oct. 10, a corporal from Anne Arundel’s Office of the Sheriff responded to a report of embezzlement at 1821 Crownsville Road, where the Renaissance Festival is located. A co-owner of Royalty Foods Ltd. said an employee had embezzled a large sum of money, according to charging documents.
 Royalty Foods operates several food concession stands between August and October, documents say. A Maryland Renaissance Festival employee confirmed to the Capital Gazette on Thursday that the company is a concessionaire there.
